findings.claim: step 4 said checkout was "at its version tag", which misread as v4 being the shipped version

verdict.text: The one finding sent back, f1, is fixed.
Step 4 of the how-to now says the quoted block uses `actions/checkout@v4` in place of the pinned commit SHA, so it no longer suggests v4 is what ci.yml ships.
The sentence now reads "... replaced by the action's repository and a ref, and `actions/checkout@v4` in place of the pinned commit SHA:", and the quoted block that follows uses `actions/checkout@v4`.
`git status` in the worktree shows the same four paths as round 1: knowledge.yml deleted, the how-to modified, and ci.yml and tests/test_ci.py untracked.
`loopctl gate stamp`: lint, format, tests and integration pass, and rows r1 to r7 pass.
Row r7, which parses the step 4 sentence, still passes with the new wording.
The how-to's step 4 wording now names `actions/checkout@v4` as a stand-in for the pinned SHA.
